test_objective: Check that you can upsert a batch of entities with update option

test_cases.name: 004_04_01 EntityWithSimpleProperties
test_cases.doc: Check that you can upsert a batch of entities with update option
test_cases.template: Batch Upsert Entities With Update Option Scenarios
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entities Request: and
    Query Parameter: entity_ids set to '${expected_updated_entities_ids}' and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to 'Building' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/ld+json'
}
